content: NLP approaches for information extraction within the biomedical research areas range from rule-based systems BIBREF3 , to domain-specific systems using feature-based classification BIBREF1 , to the recent deep networks for end-to-end feature extraction and classification BIBREF0 . NLP has had varied degree of success with free-text pathology reports BIBREF4 . Various studies have acknowledge the success of NLP in interpreting pathology reports, especially for classification tasks or extracting a single attribute from a report BIBREF4 , BIBREF5 .
